overview.title: Welcome to Ouarzazate — door to the desert
overview.p1: Ouarzazate sits where the High Atlas opens toward the pre-Saharan plateaus. Kasbah Taourirt anchors the town; Atlas Studios and Aït Benhaddou explain why this place became a film and heritage landmark. From here, roads push east to Skoura and the Dadès, and south into the Draa.
overview.p2: Two or three days cover the town kasbah, a studio visit and Aït Benhaddou, with room for Fint Oasis or Tifoultoute. Stay in town for logistics, or near Skoura for quieter palm-grove nights.

itinerary.title: 3 days in Ouarzazate
itinerary.subtitle: Town and studios first, then Aït Benhaddou, then oasis or gorge options.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Explore the Glaoui kasbah courtyards and terraces at the edge of town.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Walk the outdoor sets and desert backdrops that made Ouarzazate a film hub.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Simple dinner in the centre; early night if tomorrow is Aït Benhaddou.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Leave early for the UNESCO ksar; climb for the classic panorama.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Explore the fortified village, then lunch on the modern bank.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Back to town; optional Cinema Museum if energy remains.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Choose palms and village paths, or a quieter hill kasbah viewpoint.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Palm grove toward the Dadès, or shopping and rest in town.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Continue toward Dadès, Draa/Zagora or back to Marrakech depending on your route.

q1.question: How many days in Ouarzazate?
q1.answer: Two full days cover Taourirt, Atlas Studios and Aït Benhaddou. A third day suits Fint, Skoura or the start of a desert route.

q2.question: Is Ouarzazate only a stopover?
q2.answer: It is a logistics hub, but the kasbah, studios and Aït Benhaddou justify one or two nights on their own.

q3.question: How do I get to Ouarzazate?
q3.answer: Ouarzazate Airport (OZZ) has limited flights. Most travellers arrive by road from Marrakech (about 4–5 hours) or continue from the desert circuit.

q4.question: Best time to visit Ouarzazate?
q4.answer: Spring and autumn for milder days. Summer is very hot; winter is clear but cold at night.
